_comment: Tool definitions (Anthropic tool-use format) for an AI agent that answers questions about a manufacturer's contracts using Node & Nerve. Each tool maps to one HTTP endpoint; the agent must not compute or invent figures itself. Not tested against a live model in this repository.

tools.name: investigate_contract
tools.description: Recorded direct cost, provisional profit, money owed, and missing or conflicting information for one manufacturing contract. Calls POST /v1/companies/{company}/contracts/investigations. Every figure in the result is computed by Node & Nerve from recorded entries; cite the source_ids and keep the 'provisional' label.

tools.name: list_contracts
tools.description: All contracts with value, recorded cost, provisional profit, amount still to receive, and which have incomplete cost records. Calls GET /v1/companies/{company}/contracts.

tools.name: list_unallocated_costs
tools.description: Recorded costs not charged to any contract (overheads, unassigned labour, costs awaiting a split) and supplier payments not applied to any bill. Calls GET /v1/companies/{company}/costs/unallocated.

tools.name: list_changes_since
tools.description: Cost records, payments and allocations added or changed after a timestamp. Calls GET /v1/companies/{company}/costs/changes?since=.
